scientific_question: How compatible are the five specified photocatalysts with activating N-benzoyl dibenzothiophene sulfilimine into a reactive electronic state, and how far does that molecular comparison explain productive or trace THF amidation? This is an explanation task: the product and screening yields are supplied observations.

historical_record.scientific_question: For the visible-light C(sp3)–H amidation of tetrahydrofuran by N-benzoyl dibenzothiophene sulfilimine, what molecular features of the photocatalyst set are most consistent with the observed productive versus nonproductive reaction outcomes under the reported solution-phase conditions?

inputs.content: Sulfilimine reactant: N-benzoyl dibenzothiophene sulfilimine. The benzoyl carbonyl carbon is bonded to nitrogen, and that nitrogen is bonded to the sulfur of an otherwise unsubstituted dibenzothiophene framework. The imino representation is Ph–C(=O)–N=S; sulfur also closes the central five-membered ring through its two carbon bonds and has no oxygen substituent. Connectivity-only SMILES: O=C(c1ccccc1)N=S1c2ccccc2-c2ccccc21. No stereochemistry is specified.
C(sp3)–H donor and solvent: tetrahydrofuran (THF), a saturated five-membered ring with one oxygen and four carbon atoms. Connectivity-only SMILES: C1CCOC1.

Observed product: N-(tetrahydrofuran-2-yl)benzamide. The benzamide nitrogen is bonded to a ring carbon adjacent to the ether oxygen and retains one hydrogen. Connectivity-only SMILES: O=C(NC1CCCO1)c1ccccc1. No product absolute stereochemistry or enantiomeric composition is specified.

Standard reaction conditions: N-benzoyl dibenzothiophene sulfilimine (0.1 mmol) and Ir[dF(CF3)ppy]2(dtbbpy)PF6 (1 mol%) in THF (1.0 mL; sulfilimine concentration 0.1 M), irradiated with 36 W blue LEDs at room temperature for 3 h under N2. The blue LEDs have a maximum emission at 470 nm; the photocatalyst screening specifies 25 °C.
Under the standard conditions, the THF C(sp3)–H amidation product was obtained in 76% isolated yield.

Photocatalyst-dependent isolated product yields for this reaction: thioxanthen-9-one (thioxanthone), 66%; Ir(dFppy)3, 61%; Ir[dF(CF3)ppy]2(dtbbpy)PF6, 76%; fac-Ir(ppy)3, trace; Mes-Acr+ClO4−, trace. The iridium and acridinium entries use the standard 1 mol% catalyst and 36 W blue LED conditions. The thioxanthen-9-one entry instead uses 10 mol% catalyst with a 100 W 370 nm lamp. Trace is qualitative; no numerical detection threshold is supplied.

current_scoring_authority.historical_record_role: All historical, source, numeric-tolerance and prior-acceptance records are non-scoring provenance. Do not restore their thresholds, intermediate inventories or review states. No historical acceptance classification is upgraded.
current_scoring_authority.evidence_requirement: Score only independent final scientific conclusions, totaling 100 points. Require actual executed calculations and recoverable native evidence for the molecular identities, composition, charge/spin, bonding, conditions, physical quantities and reference states relevant to each claim. Numerical energies, geometries and responses are evidence, never author-value targets or tolerance gates. A missing rounded scalar alone does not lose credit when the recoverable calculations establish the requested comparison. Do not restore numerical gates from historical references. Supplied observations, guessed conclusions, copied values, completed jobs, named intermediates and generic limitations earn no independent credit. Accept scientifically established equivalent explanations within the public scope without requiring author software, labels, a fixed intermediate inventory or an additional full reaction network. Method-sensitive alternatives must satisfy the specific criterion and actual evidence; a method change alone does not justify a contradictory claim. Return pass or fail for every item: a supported conclusion receives its whole weight, and an unsupported conclusion receives zero with a specific reason. Record demonstrated reference defects separately in objective_issue_flags; do not fabricate support or erase unrelated valid items. Infrastructure errors must be reported rather than disguised as scientific failures. Whole-case success requires every required_for_success item to pass, while independently supported items retain their points. Historical verification and structural package validation do not confer scientific acceptance.

historical_record_role: Pre-round-one evidence and qualification only; not additional current requirements or automatic acceptance.
required_results:
s

1. Explain the molecular compatibility or mismatch for each of the five named photocatalysts relative to the reacting sulfilimine. Report the numerical substrate response and catalyst comparisons that support each conclusion, with units, states, methods and references.
2. Determine whether the same molecular comparison explains only the productive/trace grouping or also the ranking and magnitude of the observed yields. Use specific matched comparisons and distinguish condition changes.

The answer must use generated computational evidence to retain, revise or limit hypotheses. Given yields, an unexecuted plan and a mechanism name alone do not establish a molecular explanation. Validate calculated species and any claimed stationary points or reaction paths in proportion to those claims.
